in_hebrew.name: Erastes
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Erastes הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'erastes', meaning 'beloved'. This name was used in ancient Greece to describe a lover or admirer. In Christian tradition, it is believed to represent the love of God towards man.
